concept: Recovering from a significant professional or financial setback without letting it define your identity
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Stoic identity-versus-circumstance tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario involving a significant setback (job loss, failed venture, financial loss) that could easily become a self-defining narrative
exercise.reflection_prompt: What's the difference between 'this happened to me' and 'this is who I am now'?
exercise.practice: Adult separates the factual setback from any identity-level conclusions they've attached to it

assessment.success_marker: adult explicitly separates the event from an identity claim, rather than treating them as the same thing
